cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Be Right in Retrospect
cards.instruction: Perform certainty by reinterpreting every surprise as something your earlier words were obviously predicting.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll sort the refund. I said this holiday would have a sunny ending, and a cheque will brighten things up.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You said sunny weather. We spent a week indoors.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Which is why we're getting the money back. Give me the receipts; I'll make the call.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You booked it. You explain why we packed sunglasses for a flood.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll tell them I chose the dates. When the cheque comes, I want you to remember who forecast a sunny ending.

reason: A now accepts personal accountability on the call and asks B to credit the earlier forecast if the refund arrives, avoiding a detached sunglasses joke.
